summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. (BEP) filed a Form 6-K disclosing an arrangement agreement among BEP, Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (BEP Inc.), and Brookfield Renewable Corporation (BEPC) dated July 21, 2026, to complete a plan of arrangement. The transaction aims to consolidate BEP and BEPC under BEP Inc., a newly formed corporation, to deliver additional benefits to unitholders and shareholders. Consideration involves exchanging BEP units and BEPC shares for securities of BEP Inc. The BEP board, advised by Scotia Capital Inc., received a fairness opinion. The arrangement requires court interim order, unitholder/shareholder meetings, and regulatory approvals. Watch for shareholder votes and court final order timing.
